test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Rohit laid down his proposal, and told Rohit that the __ball was now in his court.__

options.text: He had to continue the remaining time in court
He had to play the game and win the match
The captaincy of the team was on his shoulders
It is Rohit's responsibility to take the next action or decision

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"the ball is in your court"** means that it is now someone else's responsibility to take action or make a decision. (अब आपकी जिम्मेदारी है) • **Example: **I've done all I can; now the ball is in your court to make the final decision. • **Responsibility** refers to the state or fact of having a duty to deal with something or of having control over someone. (जिम्मेदारी) • **Example: **As the project manager, it is her responsibility to ensure that all deadlines are met. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** He had to continue the remaining time in court (उसे अदालत में शेष समय जारी रखना था) • **Example:** The judge told him that he had to continue the remaining time in court to complete the hearing. • **Option 2:** He had to play the game and win the match (उसे खेल खेलना और मैच जीतना था) • **Example:** The coach motivated him by saying he had to play the game and win the match. • **Option 3:** The captaincy of the team was on his shoulders (टीम की कप्तानी उसके कंधों पर थी) • **Example:** After the previous captain retired, the captaincy of the team was on his shoulders. 3d:Ta5b, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
